title: Unsharp Measurement with Adaptive Gaussian POVMs for Quantum-Inspired Image Processing
summary: We propose a data-adaptive probabilistic intensity remapping framework for structure-preserving transformation of grayscale images. The suggested method formulates intensity transformation as a continuous, data-driven remapping process, in contrast to traditional histogram-based techniques that rely on hard thresholding and generate piecewise-constant mappings. The image statistics yield representative intensity values, and Gaussian-based weighting methods probabilistically allocate each pixel to several components.
